Young Bud.description: Early bud formation stage; the flower bud is small, tightly closed, and still developing
Young Bud.typical_days_to_harvest: approximately 35-45 days remaining (highly cultivar and climate dependent)

Mature Bud.description: Bud has grown larger and begins to show yellow petal tips just before opening

Early Bloom.description: Flower has just opened; outer ray petals visible, disk florets not yet fully mature

Full Bloom.description: Flower head fully open, petals fully extended, disk florets maturing

Wilted.description: Petals have dried and dropped, flower head is drooping and turning brown/yellow - this is the natural late-stage appearance when seeds are approaching maturity
Wilted.typical_days_to_harvest: approximately 0-10 days remaining if this stage is due to natural maturity
Wilted.verify_note: IMPORTANT: this stage can also be caused prematurely by disease stress rather than true maturity - in the combined mode, cross-check against disease detection before trusting this harvest estimate
